xBRZ ("scale by rules") upscaler by Zenju, from the HqMAME project.

Copied unchanged from PPSSPP's `ext/xbrz` (github.com/hrydgard/ppsspp, commit
9f286ee4ca10) except for removing PPSSPP's platform header from `xbrz.h`.
